label: Written notice of the incident to the provincial director (WCL1 or WCL2)
caveat: Exclusions may apply (OHSA s24(3), e.g. a traffic accident on a public road); this deadline is shown regardless.
source_ref: General Administrative Regulations, 2003, reg 8(1)(a); OHSA s24(1)(a)

label: Report the incident to the provincial director forthwith by telephone or similar
caveat: Exclusions may apply (OHSA s24(3), e.g. a traffic accident on a public road); this deadline is shown regardless.
source_ref: General Administrative Regulations, 2003, reg 8(1)(b); OHSA s24(1)

label: Notify the provincial director forthwith that a reported injured person has died
Notify the provincial director of the construction work (Annexure 2)
caveat: Counted as 7 clear days (neither the day of the notice nor the start day counted): our reading of "at least 7 days before"; no court ruling was found. Reg 4 binds the contractor who intends to carry out the work; Annexure 2 is completed by the principal contractor.

label: Client applies to the provincial director for a construction work permit (Annexure 1)
caveat: Counted as 30 clear days: our reading of "at least 30 days before"; no court ruling was found. Reg 3 binds the client (or its agent, reg 5(5)); whether that is this organisation depends on its role on the site, which SiteProof does not record yet. Thresholds are GN 850 of 2018's; its current status was not confirmed against the Gazette.
source_ref: Construction Regulations, 2014, reg 3(1) and 2(2); GN 850 of 2018 (GG 41839)
